# Turco Porto

> Turkish home cooking popping up around Porto, Portugal. Run by Tuna (Tunahan), a cook from Mersin, Türkiye, who has lived in Porto since 2023. Website: https://turcoporto.com

## What it is
- Pop-up dinners: one or two a month in bars, clubs and gardens around Porto, Matosinhos and Gaia. Set menu, shared plates.
- Open House: Tuna's home in Matosinhos opens for a day. Eat inside, at the door, or take food to the beach. No booking.
- Kahvaltı Club: a long Turkish breakfast for a few guests at Tuna's table. Apply by DM on Instagram.
- Private dinners and catering: dinners at home, celebrations, team lunches and company events around Porto. Contact: hey@techsalestr.com or Instagram @turcoporto.

## Food
Real Turkish home food from Mersin to Istanbul. Dishes that come back often: lahmacun, muhammara, tereyağlı humus, çiğ köfte, mercimek çorbası, fırın kuzu on iç pilav, şiş köfte, sütlaç, lokma, çay and Türk kahvesi. Breakfast: menemen, çılbır, gözleme, pişi, homemade simit, sucuk, serpme.

## Upcoming
- 25 October 2026, 12:00 to 18:00: Open House, Av. Meneres, Matosinhos. No booking needed.
- 8 November 2026, 11:00: Kahvaltı Club, Matosinhos. Free, 4 seats. Apply by DM "KAHVALTI" on Instagram by 2 November.
